summary: VAD agent team v19 — SNH (Supervised Normality Head): the v17-record-mandated successor to CNV for the owner-directed NORMAL-video false-positive objective. v17 closed CNV on HARM (v171 paired -0.00969, FA -2.6%, 13 GT vetoes; v172 tighten: FA 0%, 6 GT vetoes) and its C-record ruled: any future Normal-FP lever must be a NEW SUPERVISED mechanism that FIRST demonstrates on TRAIN normals that its video-level gate fires on normals at all. SNH = a tiny supervised video-level P(normal) head (logistic regression / tiny MLP) trained on TRAIN-split videos ONLY, over ~15-25 aggregate features computed from the pipeline's OWN cached signal families (MIL snippet scores max/topk-mean/std/frac>0.5; fused CLIP category-curve stats incl. max-z and top-decile prominence; CLIP Normal-prompt similarity stats; motion-energy outlier fraction/max-z) — zero VLM calls at train AND eval time, all local compute. TWO-PHASE HONESTY DESIGN: PHASE 0 (offline, NO eval spend) extracts features for ~50 train-normal + ~50 train-anomaly videos (standalone extractor reusing pipeline modules: video preprocessing + CLIP ViT-L + model_mil.pth + frame-diff motion — the v17 council proved this is cheap local compute), trains with cross-validation, and applies the PRE-REGISTERED GO GATE: video-level gate (P(normal) >= tau, tau chosen on TRAIN ONLY at the largest value keeping CV anomaly-flag-rate <= 5%) must flag >= 40% of train NORMAL videos. NO-GO -> write the record closing the video-level-gate direction and STOP (no eval). GO -> implement --snh_veto (default OFF) as a terminal-slot confidence veto REUSING the v171 CNV veto plumbing (confidence := 0.0, detection kept, [SNH-FIRE] conf=old->new marker lines in the analysis_bootstrap_ab.py restore_pre_marker conf-mode format + unconditional [SNH-VID] per video incl. empty/early-return paths), eval ONCE on the full 290 (NO --categories; Normal videos are the subject), adjudicate with the PROVEN paired-log conf restore (exact paired, zero VLM noise). PROMOTION GATES (same as v17, pre-registered): paired mAP delta >= -0.003 AND abs >= 0.16454 AND Normal-video FA-rate relative reduction >= 25% AND <= 1 GT-overlapping (IoU>=0.1) detection vetoed. Committed pipeline = v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal (all default-ON, full-290 ~0.173); cgr/ccr/cnv/kfd all default-OFF and stay so. Concurrency 2. NONE of the 10 banned families; this is judged on the FA-rate objective with mAP only as a non-inferiority constraint — NOT Normal-FP-for-mAP (banned 9).
args: v19: SNH (Supervised Normality Head) — the v17-mandated supervised successor for the Normal-video false-alarm objective. Offline-first honesty design: extract video-level features on ~50+50 TRAIN videos (zero VLM), train P(normal) head with CV, pre-registered GO gate (flag >=40% train normals at <=5% anomaly-flag). Only on GO: --snh_veto terminal confidence-veto reusing the CNV paired-log plumbing, one full-290 eval, gates = paired mAP delta >= -0.003 AND abs >= 0.16454 AND FA-rate relative reduction >= 25% AND <= 1 GT veto. NO-GO closes the direction with zero eval spend.

phases.detail: offline: standalone extractor (no VLM) computes video-level feature vectors for ~50+50 TRAIN videos, nohup + poll

phases.title: TrainDemo
phases.detail: train the head with CV; PRE-REGISTERED GO gate (flag >=40% train normals AND <=5% train anomaly at TRAIN-chosen tau). NO-GO closes the direction with zero eval spend

phases.title: Implement
phases.detail: D1 wires --snh_veto (default OFF) reusing the CNV veto plumbing; self-test incl. forced-fire restore proof

phases.title: Eval290
phases.detail: one full-290 eval, paired-log conf bootstrap + Normal FA rates + GT-veto harm check

phases.title: Decide
phases.detail: promote default-ON iff all four legs pass; else archive-close; summary + ledger + state-of-the-union after three straight closures

You are Agent D0. Build the SNH TRAIN-split feature file — OFFLINE, zero VLM calls, zero eval spend. StructuredOutput EXACTLY ONCE.

PROJECT: video anomaly detection + TEMPORAL LOCALIZATION on UCF-Crime. Repo /Users/zzl/PycharmProjects/vad; code /Users/zzl/PycharmProjects/vad/video_anomaly_detection. INTERPRETER python3.14.
GIT RULE: the uncommitted working tree IS the latest code. NEVER git checkout/reset/stash/clean. Back up to /Users/zzl/PycharmProjects/vad/.qoder/backups/<version>/ before editing.

!!! COMMITTED PIPELINE: v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal ALL DEFAULT-ON (full-290 ~0.173). cgr/ccr/cnv/kfd_uniform all DEFAULT-OFF (v16 closed relocation; v17 closed CNV on HARM; v18 closed KFD-U — coverage was necessary not sufficient: 0/8 newly-visible GTs converted). Do NOT change any committed default. !!!

!!! WHY SNH, AND THE LESSON IT MUST ENCODE !!!
v17 CNV failed because its gate was an UNSUPERVISED conjunct of weak signals: 30/41 of its vetoes hit ANOMALY videos (13 overlapped GT) while buying only 2.6% FA reduction. The v17 C-record mandate: a Normal-FP lever must be SUPERVISED and must FIRST demonstrate on TRAIN normals that its video-level gate fires on normals at all. SNH trains P(normal) on video-level labels (train split only) over the SAME signal families, so the veto points are chosen by supervision, not by a hand-built conjunct.

!!! FEATURES (pre-registered, ~15-25 dims, ALL from cached/local signal families — zero VLM) !!!
Per video, from a STANDALONE extractor that reuses pipeline modules (VideoPreprocessor fps=2 + motion filter; anomaly_expert CLIP ViT-L text-sims incl. the 13 category prompts AND the Normal prompt; model_mil.pth MILAnomalyScorer; frame-diff motion energy):
  MIL snippet scores: max, top-3 mean, top-8 mean, std, fraction > 0.5
  fused top-1-category curve (cat/(cat+normal) of the video's top CLIP category): max-z vs median/MAD, top-decile prominence, mean, std
  max over ALL 13 categories of curve max-z
  CLIP Normal-prompt similarity curve: mean, min-z, bottom-decile
  motion energy: outlier fraction (median+3*MAD), max-z, mean
The SAME feature function is used at train-extraction time and inside the pipeline at eval time (shared module — no train/eval skew).

!!! THE VETO MECHANICS (reuse v171 CNV plumbing verbatim) !!!
Terminal slot (after CBT, final list): if P(normal) >= tau -> veto ALL the video's detections: confidence := 0.0, detection KEPT (FM2 count frozen, index-aligned), one SNH-FIRE line per vetoed detection in EXACTLY the restore_pre_marker conf-mode format (vid + t_start + t_end + conf=old->new — copy the CNV producer grep cnv_veto/CNV-FIRE in pipeline.py). SNH-VID unconditional per video incl. 0-detection and early-return-normal paths (same call sites as CNV-VID). Stage-2 per-segment veto from CNV is NOT carried over — v17 showed segment-level vetoes on anomaly videos were the harm vector; SNH is video-level ONLY.

!!! GATES (pre-registered) !!!
GO gate (offline, TRAIN split, cross-validation): tau = largest threshold with CV anomaly-flag-rate <= 5%; GO iff the gate then flags >= 40% of train NORMAL videos (and report the ROC-AUC). NO-GO -> the video-level-gate direction is closed with zero eval spend — that is a VALID outcome.
PROMOTION gate (full-290, paired-log conf restore): paired mAP delta >= -0.003 AND abs >= 0.16454 AND Normal-video FA-rate relative reduction >= 25% AND GT-overlapping (IoU>=0.1) vetoes <= 1.

FM DISCIPLINE: FM2 count frozen. FM5 SNH-FIRE must fire. FM17 SNH-VID on EVERY path. FM20 grep not claim. FM21 exact marker strings. FM18 absolute mAP. NO TEST-SET TUNING: tau and the head are fixed by TRAIN data only; the 290 run is the first and only time test videos are scored. HARNESS: full 290, NO --categories, --concurrency 2.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: flag default OFF (byte-identical off); CLI in BOTH run.py and batch_evaluate.py; StructuredOutput EXACTLY ONCE per agent; no Bash > ~150s except stated smokes/extraction (which run via nohup + poll).

Per video: preprocess (fps=2 + motion filter), CLIP ViT-L frame feats, the 13-category + Normal text-sim curves (pipeline-exact softmax -> cat/(cat+normal)), MIL snippet scores from model_mil.pth, frame-diff motion energy -> emit ONE JSONL line per video with {video, label (normal=1 iff a Training_Normal video, else 0), category, features{...the pre-registered families...}}.
